title: Binary search misses a match
explanation: hi is an inclusive bound, so when lo === hi there is still one unchecked candidate. With inclusive bounds, loop while lo <= hi.
hint: Trace it with a single element. Does the loop body run at all?

title: Window sum is too small
explanation: When nums[i] enters a window of size k, the element leaving is nums[i - k]. The + 1 removes the wrong element, one that's still inside the window.
hint: When index i enters a window of size k, which index leaves?

title: Reachability check hangs
prompt: Hangs forever when the graph has a cycle and goal can't be reached.
explanation: Nodes are checked against seen but never added to it, so a cycle pushes the same nodes forever. Mark a node as seen when you push it.
hint: Something is read from seen. Where is it ever written?
